in maps
, if you are not, click
here for the leveling guide
New Video Update out:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dmv8PyVVlXU

I think cold djinn is entirely unworth it with the new buffs unless there is a new tech with ward skills or something, so that tree is not optimized as much as it could be since i am not playing it, so you should swap some nodes around for archon effect.
Build slightly nerfed: Damage for
is capped to 300% more with susbsequent casts, so far it feels pretty much the same to me.
This build essentially becomes a 1 button build with no archon cooldown once you get
(contempt, suffering, isolation, ancient emotions do not work) anoint and you can just keep spamming
and kelaris brutality to keep up crit weakness
Massive Buffs for 0.5:

Fixed a bug that caused the minion damage bonus against non-unique enemies introduced in version 0.3 to function incorrectly. Depending on specific circumstances, this will result in very little change to early minion damage, approximately 25-35% more late-game minion damage against non-unique enemies, and approximately 20-25% more late-game minion damage against unique enemies. This bonus is also no longer factored into the damage numbers displayed for skills of your minions.
Breach tree jewelry can add minion damage mods
This build is largely unaffected by the Energy Shield nerfs compared to other builds due to the
ascendancy node /
It will be one of the few ascendancies that energy shield will still be very OP early
All Command Skills now have a 50% movement speed penalty during skill use (previously 70%).

New nodes on the tree with a buff called puppet master - grants 10% skill speed with command, 10% reduced movement speed penalty, 10% increased, minions 2% movespeed, and minions 3% skill speed PER STACK???
New archon of undeath node - 25% MORE minion damage, 200% MORE cooldown recovery rate for command skills
More minion command cooldown nodes on the tree
(secret anoint) can be used for permanent archon
CHECK FOR MORE INFO UNDER EACH SECTION, ctrl + f is a GREAT utility
What is the difference between djinns?:
is by far the best one, having the best DPS and utility applying critical weakness on enemies, AND it is still decent at clearing packs.
is the second best,
is very nice for supplemental clear and DPS. It can also be used to keep perma 6 stacks on puppet master and trigger undead archon with ruzhans brand
is the worst but still good it just requires a 3 button piano combo between
, picking up remnants,
and

which is probably annoying for most people, but satisfying screen wide pops. I don't think it is better in clear speed than the other 2 despite being screen wide AoE due to how long the combo takes to cast. Some people mention using a cold quill crab spectre to automatically apply chilled ground but I didn't have much success with that, maybe there is a secret tech.
Misc Info:
You can disenchant your spectre gem to get a base version back and not waste it.
You can swap to CI around 6k ES
You get additional sockets for your djinns by leveling up - levels that grant additional sockets are 40, 65, and 90.
If you are randomly getting chunked try getting rid of
but I haven't had any problem with it
Cold, fire, phys levels on wands / staffs do not level up your djinns
You can use ruzhans brand to have perma 6 stacks puppet master
Get 1 of each minion type for
then any extra spirit can be for getting more spectres. Once you have 1 of each you can either dump the rest into spectres or get
with
for perma 3 abyss mods and
https://poe.ninja/poe2/profile/dslily-1229/runesofaldur/character/lilydjinnopwtf
Pillars: movement speed or global defence
Venom Draught: Stun threshold
Tattoos: Resistance
Shark fin: 30% es
FAQ:
Q: There's too many gems A: Take the less important ones out
Q: is there a filter A: no just use filterblade
Q: how to fix mana problems? A: press your mana flask or stop holding down your mouse button and just click, holding it down costs more mana than the times it actually casts.
Q: what dmg stats work? A: Any minion stats work, spell / atk damage on yourself does not work, but cast speed does. I dont think getting cast speed is worth tho
Q: when should i start using
A: when you can afford it
Q: My djinn cooldowns are not decreasing when i have archon for a few seconds A: there is a bug where if you keep casting it at 0 charges left it doesnt give you the cooldown recovery

children.text: Q: My djinn cooldowns are not decreasing when i have archon for a few seconds A: there is a bug where if you keep casting it at 0 charges left it doesnt give you the cooldown recovery.

This isnt a bug, the cooldown isnt applied to the skill used to proc the buff until the procing skills normal cooldown ends. easy fix is to spam ruzhan mark between archon downtime time get it going again
